company.name: Otmost
company.shortDescription: Otmost is a cashless solution to reinvent the way businesses used to do transactions.
company.description: Otmost is a cashless solution to reinvent the way businesses used to do transactions. Otmost is designed particularly for B2B transactions, where businesses can sell their unused (not utilized) capacity in exchange for Mosto's (Pseudo-currency). So they can buy and sell any business service on the platform as long as they have enough Mosto's in their accounts.
